issue_title: [Bug] Todo.id accepts negative and zero values without validation
approach: Add validation in Todo.__post_init__ and Todo.from_dict to reject non-positive id values
summary: Added validation to ensure Todo.id must be a positive integer (> 0). Validation occurs both in __post_init__ (for direct construction) and in from_dict (for loading from dict). This prevents invalid state from being created.
risks: Minimal - existing code that relied on id=0 will now raise ValueError. Tests were updated to use positive IDs.
